stem.en: The major organs are forming, and the mother cannot yet feel any movement. Which is the stage, and what is the developing baby called?

text.en: First trimester; it is a foetus from the first day

feedback.en: The name foetus begins at about the ninth week.

text.en: First trimester; it is called an embryo

feedback.en: Correct. Major organs start forming in the first two months.

text.en: Second trimester; it is called an embryo for now

feedback.en: In the second trimester it is a foetus, and movements can usually be felt.

text.en: Third trimester; it is called an embryo until birth

feedback.en: By the third trimester it has been a foetus for months.

explanation.en: In the first trimester, the fertilised egg develops into an embryo and major organs start forming. From about the ninth week it is called a foetus. The mother can usually feel movements in the second trimester.

hints.en: In which stage do the major organs start forming?
When does the name foetus begin?
